title: Heterogeneity-Aware Belief Synchronization for Semantic Communication in AI-Native 6G Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.13394v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 6G networks will not be serving as communication infrastructures only; rather, they are expected to evolve into intelligent systems, where thousands of autonomous artificial intelligence (AI) agents are interconnected. The agents are deployed across a wide range of platforms including low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites, high-altitude platforms (HAPs), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), edge servers, and terrestrial devices. These agents continuously observe their environment and exchange information. Semantic communication provides an efficient mechanism for exchanging meaningful information instead of raw data. However, its effectiveness depends on the communicating agents having sufficiently aligned beliefs to correctly interpret and decode the transmitted messages. translated_title: 面向AI原生6G网络中异构感知的语义通信信念同步
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13394v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：6G网络将不仅仅是通信基础设施；相反，它们预计将演变为智能系统，其中数千个自主人工智能（AI）代理相互连接。这些代理部署在广泛的平台上，包括低地球轨道（LEO）卫星、高空平台（HAPs）、无人机（UAVs）、边缘服务器和地面设备。这些代理持续观察其环境并交换信息。语义通信提供了一种高效机制，用于交换有意义的信息而非原始数据。然而，其有效性取决于通信代理是否具有足够对齐的信念，以正确解释和解码传输的消息。在6G网络中，这一假设难以满足，因为异构AI模型在多样化的计算约束下运行，并持续获取不同的信息。
tldr: 本文提出了一种异构感知的信念同步机制，以解决AI原生6G网络中异构AI代理因计算约束和信息差异导致的语义通信误解问题，从而确保高效且可靠的信息交换。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a heterogeneity-aware belief synchronization mechanism to address semantic communication misinterpretation caused by diverse computational constraints and information disparities among AI agents in AI-native 6G networks, ensuring efficient and reliable information exchange.
